test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Quarrels result in_________ confrontations and bring all conversations to a complete standstill.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Heated**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The sentence talks about how quarrels bring conversations to a complete standstill. 
 
• This implies that the confrontations resulting from quarrels must be intense and disruptive.
 
• The word "**heated**" means intense or passionate, especially in the context of an argument or debate. (तीव्र या भावुक, विशेष रूप से किसी तर्क या बहस के संदर्भ में)
 
 
• **For example**: *The argument became heated as emotions ran high.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, it is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

**Complete sentence**: *Quarrels result in heated __confrontations and bring all conversations to a complete standstill.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cold **is the opposite of what the sentence suggests, as it implies a lack of intensity or passion. (तीव्रता या जुनून की कमी)
 
• **Hot **is not an appropriate choice as it suggests a physical temperature rather than an emotional state. (शारीरिक तापमान)
 
• **Disputed **is not a suitable choice as it means subject to disagreement or controversy. (असहमति या विवाद का विषय)
